description: The chart illustrates the percentage point difference for mBERT and XLM-R models across various layers, with the x-axis representing the layer numbers from 0 to 12 and an additional category labeled "concat", and the y-axis labeled "% point difference" ranging from -10 to 0 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 2. The top section of the chart displays bars for mBERT, colored in light blue, with values decreasing in magnitude as the layer number increases, starting from approximately -9.5 at layer 0 and approaching 0 at layer 9, with the "concat" category having a value slightly above 0. The bottom section of the chart shows bars for XLM-R, colored in dark blue, with a similar trend, starting from around -8.5 at layer 0 and approaching 0 at layer 9, and the "concat" category is represented by a gray bar with a value near 0. Both sets of bars are grouped by model and layer, with the layer numbers on the x-axis being the same for both models, and the bars are not sorted or visually emphasized in any particular way.
